  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then

    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \

      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
  fi

  # Ensure postgres service is running
  if ! pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Starting PostgreSQL service..." >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -l "$PGDATA/postgres.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; done
  fi

  # Create database if it doesn't exist
  createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Load schema if it exists
  if [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/db/schema.sql" ]; then
    echo "Loading schema..." >&2
    psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDATABASE" -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/db/schema.sql" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

  # Install npm dependencies
  if [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/package.json" ]; then
    cd "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT" || exit
    echo "Installing npm dependencies..." >&2
    npm install --silent >&2 || true
  fi
"""

  mkdir -p "$PGDATA"

  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA/base" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8
  fi

  exec postgres \
    -D "$PGDATA" \
    -p "$PGPORT" \
    -c "listen_addresses=$PGHOST"
"""

[profile]
bash = '''
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"

schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
nodejs_22.pkg-path = "nodejs_22"
postgresql_16.pkg-path = "postgresql_16"
jq.pkg-path = "jq"
jq.systems = ["aarch64-darwin", "aarch64-linux", "x86_64-linux"]

[vars]
PORT = "3000"
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "orders"
PGDATABASE = "orders_development"

[hook]
on-activate = """
  # Initialize npm dependencies
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    npm install --silent
  fi

  # Initialize PostgreSQL cluster and start service
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export SOCKET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/target/dev-db-socket"

  mkdir -p "$SOCKET_DIR"

  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    echo "listen_addresses = ''" >> "$PGDATA/postgresql.conf"
    echo "unix_socket_directories = '$SOCKET_DIR'" >> "$PGDATA/postgresql.conf"
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -l "$PGDATA/postgres.log" start
    until pg_isready -h "$SOCKET_DIR" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb -h "$SOCKET_DIR" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" >&2
    if [ -f db/schema.sql ]; then
      psql -h "$SOCKET_DIR" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDATABASE" -q -f db/schema.sql >&2
    fi
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast
  fi

  # Encode socket path for DATABASE_URL (contains / characters)
  ENCODED_SOCKET="$(printf '%s' "$SOCKET_DIR" | jq -sRr @uri)"
  export DATABASE_URL="postgres://${PGUSER}@${ENCODED_SOCKET}/${PGDATABASE}"
"""

[services.postgres]
command = """
  exec postgres \
    -D "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres" \
    -k "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/target/dev-db-socket" \
    -c listen_addresses=''
"""
